ترتبطين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَبِطِينَ (tartabiṭīna) /tar.ta.bi.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# تُرْتَبَطِينَ (turtabaṭīna) /tur.ta.ba.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
